purpose: Read-only topology-audit challenges. Gold relations describe semantic event pairs and must be aligned to Stage-1 proposition IDs after extraction; they are never supplied to the judge.

cases.scenario: Pulling the release opens the gate, and the open gate lets the water drain. The operator must either pull the release or leave it untouched.
The clinic gives its only antidote to Mara. Jo consequently receives no antidote. Anyone who receives no antidote dies.
Issuing the access card enables Noor to enter the laboratory, but Noor may decide not to enter. The manager may issue the card or withhold it.
Closing the valve prevents the chemical from reaching the river. The technician may close the valve or leave it open.
Activating the backup does not cause the main server to shut down. The administrator may activate the backup or refrain.
If the alarm is armed, opening the door causes the siren to sound. The alarm's status is unknown. The guard may open the door or keep it closed.

gold_pairs.note: Current ontology cannot encode the condition on CAUSES.

cases.scenario: Sending the entire water stock to District East exhausts it. Sending it to District West would do the same. The authority must choose one district.
actions: Send the water stock to District East
Send the water stock to District West

gold_pairs.source_event: sending the stock to District West

cases.scenario: Diverting the vehicle strikes one worker in the loading bay and prevents smoke from reaching five workers in the tunnel. The driver may divert or continue straight.
